summary: Iteration 195 testing complete. All backend APIs (8/8) passed. Frontend features verified: weight card (no icon, 70kg large font), weight chart (full-width, clickable points show detail card), weight save refreshes data, calendar dynamic data, exercise images from merged template data.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing user with Squat exercise (id=e2c5bcdd-b6c0-4ff6-8586-41b9460d7702)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 195 features verified. Backend beneficiary-today-exercises now merges template data (image, description, equipment, muscle_group). Weight card shows 70kg in large font without icon. Weight chart is full-width with clickable points that show detail card below with date and weight. Calendar on activity-detail page is dynamic - different dates return different exercise counts. Exercise images are correctly displayed from merged template data.

backend_beneficiary_today_exercises_merg.details: GET /api/pro/beneficiary-today-exercises returns exercises with merged template data (image, description, equipment, muscle_group). Squat has image from pexels, equipment=Barre, muscle_group=Quadriceps, Fessiers.

backend_calendar_dynamic_data.details: ?date=YYYY-MM-DD parameter works correctly. Today returns 10 exercises, different dates return different counts based on schedule.

backend_assigned_exercise_detail.details: GET /api/pro/assigned-exercise-detail/{id} returns complete exercise data with weight_history (7 entries), last_weight_kg=70, and merged template fields.

backend_weight_save.details: PUT /api/pro/assigned-exercises/{id}/save-weight correctly saves weight and returns updated last_weight_kg.

frontend_weight_card.details: Weight card shows 'POIDS UTILISE' label with 70kg in large font (~28px). No icon present. Edit button (pencil) visible.

frontend_weight_chart.details: Weight chart is full-width with 'EVOLUTION DU POIDS' label. SVG line chart with 9 clickable circle points. Clicking a point shows detail card below with date and weight (e.g., '01 avr. 2026' and '60kg').

frontend_weight_save_refresh.details: After saving weight (71kg), 'Enregistre !' message appears. Exercise data is re-fetched and chart updates. Weight restored to 70kg successfully.

frontend_calendar_dynamic.details: Horizontal calendar on activity-detail page. Clicking different dates (MER 1 vs VEN 3) shows different exercise counts (10 vs 0). Calendar navigation (prev/next month) works.

frontend_exercise_images.details: Exercise list on activity-detail shows 10 exercises with images. Squat shows correct pexels image from template. Burpees exercises also have images.

frontend_exercise_detail_consistency.details: Exercise detail page shows: title (Squat), image, difficulty (Moyen), muscle_group (Quadriceps, Fessiers), equipment (Barre), stats (10 series, 21 reps, 130s repos), description, steps.

professional_routes_lines_2017-2029.details: Template data merge logic correctly iterates through template fields (image, video_url, steps, description, icon, equipment, muscle_group, difficulty, category) and copies to exercise if not already present.

pro-exercise-detail_tsx_WeightChart.details: WeightChart component (lines 391-443) renders full-width SVG with clickable circles. Selected point shows detail card with date and weight.

pro-exercise-detail_tsx_weight_card.details: Weight tracker card (lines 232-262) shows 'POIDS UTILISE' label, large weight (28px font), no icon, edit button. WeightChart rendered inside when weight_history > 1.

activity-detail_tsx_calendar.details: HorizontalCalendar component with date selection. fetchData uses selectedDate to call beneficiary-today-exercises with ?date= parameter.
